items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And we wrote his first music and got him started.

ctx.x: Well, they were name acts -- they were name acts like today, with guys like Billy Eckstine, But, see, it was a proving ground for all these acts. They were young. See, we're talking about the '40s and things like that then, you know. Billy Eckstine, he got his start there, and George Kirby was -- at that time, he was a busboy there.
